answer: Picture the old fable of the trellis: every new vine must be tied to an existing post, and a post only holds so much. Our agent registry works the same way. Each identity registers under a sponsor, and the sponsor's reward weight is shared across its whole subtree, never added to. An operator who unloads a hundred clones at the wharf of one sponsor just slices the same weight a hundred ways, so the farm earns what one honest agent would, minus the upkeep.
